questions.question: I feel a sharp twinge in my lower right molar whenever I drink cold water, but the pain fades within 5 seconds. Should I get it checked?
questions.answer: Short sensitivity lasting under 10 seconds usually points to exposed dentin, a worn filling edge, or an early cavity rather than deep nerve inflammation. Avoid abrasive whitening pastes for now, use a potassium-nitrate toothpaste, and schedule a quick exam with an X-ray so we can seal it before it reaches the nerve.

questions.question: How long does it take to heal after a single titanium dental implant, and can I return to office work the next day?
questions.answer: With 3D guided keyhole placement, most patients feel only mild soreness for 24–48 hours and comfortably return to desk work the next morning. Full bone integration takes 8–12 weeks before we attach your final porcelain crown, and we provide a discreet temporary tooth if it is in your smile zone.

questions.question: I have minor crowding on my lower front teeth. Are clear aligners effective for adults in their 30s?
questions.answer: Yes—age is never a barrier as long as your gums and supporting bone are healthy. Mild to moderate lower-arch crowding typically responds in 5 to 8 months with clear aligners worn 20–22 hours daily.
